claim.claim-text: 2. The dynamic photodiode of claim 1, further comprising a third doped region formed in the substrate, at the top surface of the substrate, the third doped region having an associated third contact that is grounded.

3. The dynamic photodiode of claim 1, further comprising a fourth doped region formed in the substrate, at the top surface of the substrate, the fourth doped region having an associated fourth contact configured to receive the first voltage.

4. The dynamic photodiode of claim 3, further comprising a second resettable doped region formed in the substrate, at the top surface of the substrate between the second doped region and the fourth doped region, the second resettable doped region having an associated second resettable contact configured to receive the reset voltage or be set as an open circuit.

5. The dynamic photodiode of claim 4, further comprising a second light absorbing region formed in the substrate, at the top surface of the substrate, between the second doped region and the fourth doped region, the second light absorbing region configured to generate second electron-hole pairs in the substrate, wherein the second electron-hole pairs are generated in the substrate when the second resettable contact is set as an open circuit, and the second electron-hole pairs are removed from the substrate when the second resettable contact receives the reset voltage.

6. The dynamic photodiode of claim 4, wherein the first doped region, second doped region, first resettable region, second resettable region, and fourth doped region are linear regions arranged parallel to each other.
7. The dynamic photodiode of claim 6, wherein the second resettable region is a p+ doped region, and the fourth doped region is a p+ doped region.
8. The dynamic photodiode of claim 1, wherein the first doped region surrounds the first resettable doped region.
9. The dynamic photodiode of claim 8, wherein the first resettable doped region surrounds the second doped region.
10. The dynamic photodiode of claim 2, wherein:

the third doped region is an n+ doped region; or the third doped region surrounds the first doped region; or a well is arranged below the third doped region and extends the third contact into the substrate via the third doped region.

11. The dynamic photodiode of claim 1 further comprising a back contact attached to a first side of the substrate opposite to a second side of the substrate where the first doped region, second doped region, first resettable region, and first resettable doped region are disposed.
12. The dynamic photodiode of claim 11, wherein:
the back contact is grounded; or the back contact is etched into the substrate; or a doped layer is arranged between the back contact and the substrate.
13. The dynamic photodiode of claim 11, wherein a doped layer is arranged between the back contact and the substrate and wherein the doped layer is n+ doped.

14. The dynamic photodiode of claim 2, wherein a well is arranged below the third doped region and extends the third contact into the substrate via the third doped region and wherein the well has the same doping type as the third doped region.

15. The dynamic photodiode of claim 1, further comprising an epi-layer disposed underneath the first doped region, the second doped region, the first resettable doped region, and the first light absorbing region, and further comprising:

a buried oxide region disposed underneath the epi-layer, the buried oxide region contacting the substrate; or an epitaxial layer disposed underneath the epi-layer, the epitaxial layer contacting the substrate.
